# BAD-086 — Nothing runs deno check, so the Edge Functions' type errors are invisible until someone types the command by hand

## Brief
There is no deno.json under server/supabase/functions and no deno step in any
workflow, so `deno check` never runs — not locally by default, not in
server-ci.yml. Type errors in the Edge Functions are invisible until somebody
types the command by hand, and the command itself needs
`--node-modules-dir=none` to get past the repo's node_modules shadowing
npm:postgres@3.4.5, which is not written down anywhere either.

Evidence (Charlotte, BADS-038, on an otherwise unmodified tree):
`cd server/supabase/functions && deno check --node-modules-dir=none collab/index.ts`
reports "Found 3 errors". `grep -n deno .github/workflows/*.yml` has no matches.
No deno.json exists under server/supabase/functions.

Scope is the tooling, not the errors: a deno.json (or an equivalent invocation
the server-changes skill names) that makes the check runnable without the flag
folklore, and a step that runs it where a red result is seen — server-ci.yml is
the obvious home, since it is already the authoritative run for the server half.
Whether it gates or merely reports is part of the decision; a check nobody can
go green on is worse than none.

The three TS7006 implicit-any errors it currently finds (collab/info.ts:73, 88,
99 — the .map callbacks over members, claims and takes) are NOT this ticket:
BAD-051 already lists "deno check's three TS7006s" in its comment-and-type pass
over server/supabase/functions/. This ticket makes the check runnable and run;
BAD-051 makes it pass. If they land out of order, a gating step waits for
BAD-051.
